title: 4 Days DJing On A Cruise Ship Festival (EDSea)
description: In this video I go on my first ever cruise AND my first cruise ship festival - EDSea (ran by EDC/Insomniac). I wanted to share my whole experience and show you guys what it’s like being an artist on one of these 4-day festivals. Featuring Chris Lorenzo, Hamdi, Wax Motif, Hol, San Pacho, Odd Mob, Ky William and more.
